clips.send: Send this to someone who keeps a vision board they never look at again - awe at that being the whole point.
clips.caption:
A guy told Kevin a story that still gets him excited to repeat it.

Years ago, he grabbed a piece of paper and wrote down about twenty things he wanted. Then he put it away and completely forgot about it - moved apartments, moved on with life, never looked at it again.

Four years later, going through old boxes, he found the paper. Every single thing on that list had manifested. He hadn't been chasing any of it. He'd just written it down once and let it go.

There's something in that letting go that the wanting itself actually blocks.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the exact method for writing your own list.
